title: About Solihin (Home)
snippet: Graduate student in Theoretical Condensed Matter Physics at Universitas Indonesia. Research interests include quantum magnonics.

title: Tunable Spin Response Properties in Electronically Robust Ferromagnetic $\text{CrSiSe}_3$ Monolayer under External Electric Fields
snippet: Preprint publication investigating the electronic, magnetic, and spin response properties of $\text{CrSiSe}_3$ monolayer under external out-of-plane electric fields.

title: Geometry-controlled magnon-polariton excitations in a bilayer planar cavity
snippet: Preprint publication exploring magnon-polariton coupling and coupling strength tuning of double magnetic films in planar cavities.

title: Tunable optical absorption in undoped graphene sandwiched between multilayer dielectric stacks with mirror symmetry
snippet: Published in Phys. Scr. 99 (2024). This study explores optical absorption and fields enhancement in graphene-dielectric multilayer structures.
